collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VIII (141-160, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager weaving and chatting forgot to stop, and the basket is now big enough to sleep in.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) was weaving a basket and talking with friends at the same time, and somewhere along the way (subject.he/she) forgot to stop. The basket is now big enough to sit in. Possibly big enough to sleep in. It's well made. It's just enormous. (friend) walks round it, very slowly.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They try everything. It's too big for fruit. Too big for fish. Too big to carry, by one person anyway. In the end, a group of children discover it and declare it a boat, a hut and a fort, all on the same afternoon. (subject) decides that's exactly what (subject.he/she) was making all along.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) puts it outside the hut and goes to bed. In the morning (subject.he/she) finds (friend) curled up inside it, fast asleep. "It's very comfortable," (friend) says, without opening (friend.his/her) eyes. (subject) briefly considers making a second one. Then (subject.he/she) decides one is plenty.
